regimeSub: 10Y holds 5.22% as South Korean president challenges BOK independence, Brent surges to $105 on lingering supply risks.
themes: 10Y yield unchanged at 5.22% after Thu 30Y auction relief fades → 2s10s at +47bp maintains bear steepener as term premium repricing persists with yields at 24-year highs; real rate (10Y-CPI) at 1.52% signals restrictive conditions

South Korea President publicly states rate hikes 'unavoidable' per BigGo Finance Oct 13 → rare challenge to BOK independence as Governor faces parliamentary scrutiny; KOSPI -7% to 6001 from 6420 as won weakens to 1344 on policy credibility concerns

Warsh Fed remains boxed: Sep NFP +29K miss per CNBC with unemployment rising to 4.2% yet Aug CPI sticky at 3.7% YoY and core PCE at 3.0% → Williams Oct 8 'sees no urgency for next rate hike' per Reuters buys time but stagflation trap deepens

Brent +2.1% to $105.48 as Saudi output disruptions from Iran war persist despite Jun interim deal → gold +$0 at $4224 ATH holds as stagflation hedge; SPX -0.06% to 7807 as equity risk premium compresses against 5%+ yields

headline: Stagflation regime persists as South Korean political challenge to BOK independence sparks KOSPI -7% selloff while Brent breaches $105 on lingering supply disruptions.
